title: 番外 二十四年前祝予离开后2
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当时，祝今也驱车赶过去，刚好看到了被人抬出来的周复之，他脸上染着血，闭着眼不省人事。

脚步一顿，一个让她略有些眼熟的男人走了过来，她理性的想起自己先前见过这个人。

去给发烧的祝予买烤肠时，偶然救了他的女儿，没记错的话，对方是个警察。

“是你？你朋友他没事儿，只是晕过去了。”

祝今也点点头表示自己知道了，活动了一下冰凉的手，再次出口询问：“跟他在一起的那个女孩在哪里。”

得到的，却是雷队疑惑的眼神。

在接收对方目光的那瞬间，祝今也思绪有一瞬间的停滞。

接下来探查，以及李承天的尸体，让她明白，自己的预感终究成了真。

周复之昏迷不醒时，祝今也去亲自检验了祝予的消失。

一只无形的大手将她的痕迹尽数抹除。

诡异的是，所有人都不记得祝予，她却还保留着记忆。

怕这份记忆也会悄无声息的消失，祝今也用各种手段做了记录，将一切事情记下来，好在她一直都时刻准备着，如今这种情况不至于将她打的措手不及。

坐在祝予曾经认真写暑假出游计划的地方，祝今也将那一片空白的蓝色笔记本拿过来，用钢笔一笔一划的将那些消散的字全部写了回来。

做完这件事儿，她起身去了医院。

还有一个人，他或许跟自己一样，是为数不多记忆没有被抹除的人。

祝今也给予了周复之很长一段时间整理思绪的时间。

虽然当时确实抓住了一点线索，但如今在祝今也这里证实了猜想，比他想象中的更不可思议。

周复之还是震惊。

“怪不得……”

他又哭又笑的擦了擦眼泪。

怪不得她身上总带着一种游离感、怪不得她长得即像祝今也又似他、怪不得每次变故都有祝予的参与……

“我好像明白了……”

“明白了她为什么要我拍晕，为什么对李承天说出那番话。”

是为了他。

周复之垂下头捂住脸，缓了好半天，再抬起时，眼睛湿漉漉的。

“我之前还骂她爸是混蛋，不负责。”

“原来我才是那个混蛋。”

“第一见她时，瘦的跟肚子里连屎都没有似的，灰扑扑的模样，一看就是吃了不少苦。”

“……原来是我没养好她。”

“我怎么这么没用，居然还要她专门跑这一趟来帮我们……世界上怎么会有我这么没用的爸爸。”

周复之光是说着，刚才短暂整理好的心情又变成了雷雨天，眼泪扑簌簌的往下掉。

祝今也一言未发。

她又何尝不是这么想的。

直到周复之发泄完情绪，他才吞下哽咽，用红肿的双眸向祝今也求证：“那……祝予她是不是回到了未来？”

“我们还能见面吗？”

说完，他才意识到自己问了个蠢问题。

祝今也没有笑话他：“我猜，是的。”

“虽然不明白为什么只有我们还记得，但她的存在被抹除就是最好的证据。”

祝今也比周复之先早发现祝予在这个时空的消失。

空白的照片、迷茫的父母，祝予的朋友，全部不记得了她了，就连抚玉的毕业照上都没了她的照片、档案。

At that time, Zhu Jin also drove over and happened to see Zhou Fuzhi being carried out. His face was stained with blood and he was unconscious with his eyes closed.

After a pause, a man who looked slightly familiar to her walked over. She rationally remembered that she had met this man before.

When I went to buy sausages for Zhu Yu who had a fever, I accidentally saved his daughter. If I remember correctly, the other party was a policeman.

"Is it you? Your friend is fine, he just fainted."

Zhu Jin also nodded to show that he understood, moved his cold hands, and asked again: "Where is the girl who is with him."

What he got was a confused look from Captain Lei.

At the moment when he received the other party's gaze, Zhu Jinye's thoughts stopped for a moment.

The subsequent investigation, as well as Li Chengtian's body, made her understand that her premonition had finally come true.

When Zhou Fuzhi was unconscious, Zhu Jin also went to personally check Zhu Yu's disappearance.

An invisible hand erased all traces of her.

The strange thing is that no one remembers Zhu Yu, but she still retains her memory.

Afraid that this memory would disappear quietly, Zhu Jin also used various means to record everything. Fortunately, she had always been prepared, and now this situation would not catch her off guard.

Sitting in the place where Zhu Yu once carefully wrote down his summer travel plans, Zhu Jin also took the blank blue notebook and wrote back all the lost words with a pen.

After doing this, she got up and went to the hospital.

There is another person who, like himself, may be one of the few whose memories have not been erased.

Zhu Jin also gave Zhou Fuzhi a long period of time to sort out his thoughts.

Although he did catch some clues at the time, Zhu Jinye's conjecture was now confirmed, and it was more incredible than he imagined.

Zhou Fuzhi was still shocked.

"No wonder..."

He cried and laughed and wiped his tears.

No wonder she always has a sense of dissociation, no wonder she looks like Zhu Jin and him at the same time, no wonder Zhu Yu is involved in every incident...

"I seem to understand..."

"I understand why she wanted me to knock her out and why she said those words to Li Chengtian."

It's for him.

Zhou Fuzhi lowered his head and covered his face, and waited for a long time. When he raised it again, his eyes were wet.

"I called her dad a bastard and irresponsible before."

"Turns out I'm the bastard."

"When I first saw her, she was so thin that she looked like she didn't even have shit in her belly. She looked dusty. It looked like she had suffered a lot."

"...It turns out I didn't raise her well."

"Why am I so useless that I actually want her to come all the way to help us... How can there be such a useless father like me in the world?"

As Zhou Fuzhiguang said this, his mood that he had just sorted out briefly turned into a thunderstorm again, and tears fell down.

Zhu Jin didn’t say a word.

She didn't think so.

It wasn't until Zhou Fuzhi vented his emotions that he swallowed his sobs and asked Zhu Jinye for confirmation with his red and swollen eyes: "Then...has Zhu Yu returned to the future?"

"Can we still meet?"

After saying that, he realized that he had asked a stupid question.

Zhu Jin didn't laugh at him: "I guess, yes."

"Although I don't understand why we are the only ones who still remember her, the fact that her existence has been erased is the best evidence."

Zhu Jin also discovered Zhu Yu's disappearance in this time and space earlier than Zhou Fuzhi.

The blank photos, confused parents, and Zhu Yu's friends all forgot about her. Even Fuyu's graduation photos were missing her photos and files.
